scope: Deterministic identity-linkage feasibility sample; not a rank-outcome estimate or appointment effect.

sample_design.selection: smallest SHA-256 of fixed salt, institution, rank, and normalized name
sample_design.reproducibility: Selection is deterministic for the hashed PortalVS snapshot. Live OpenAlex responses and the private adjudication crosswalk were not archived publicly, so this is a feasibility record rather than a fully rerunnable outcome study.

observed_linkage_risks.notes: Names generated candidates only. Official institutional ORCID or multi-work evidence was required. Ambiguous profiles and rank conflicts were excluded.

finding: The linkage is technically feasible but manual and fragile: 11 of 12 identities passed independent review, while one merged OpenAlex profile and two current-rank conflicts reduced the usable cohort to nine.
non_finding: No citation, h-index, i10, works, or career-rate association is reported because the cohort fails minimum-cell, normalization, and common-support gates.
